item.title: [−1] Rupee Strengthens As RBI Measures Ease Forex Demand And Support Currency Rebound
item.description:
Signal: a stronger rupee. 25 reports from Investing.com India, Reuters, BusinessLine and 20 more. Related: “Rupee rises 14 paise to 94.61 against US dollar in early trade”. Turn: earlier readings (3 Nov) pointed the other way.

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks

item.description:
